Transport liveness for the participant data channel: the server pings the peer and renews the read deadline on its answer instead of closing after 60 seconds without typed input. Admission, token use, generation and driver ownership are unchanged.

models.limits: The model has no numeric timeouts, WebSocket framing or liveness, so the ping cadence and idle limit are not modeled. It still covers what a channel drop may do: detaching a consumer keeps the same driver for Resume, emits nothing after revocation and is not a guest exit. terminal_keepalive_test.go establishes the liveness behavior natively.
